title: plectrachne pungens
intro: Plectrachne pungens, commonly known as Spike Grass, is a type of perennial grass native to Australia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering several health benefits such as relief from respiratory issues and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Spike Grass include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help in clearing mucus and soothing coughs. The bioactive constituents of Plectrachne pungens include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
